nodes.label: Installer & Release Trust Chain (S-158 / 0.5.1 impl C)
nodes.rationale: Commits checksum manifests into the git tree before signing the release tag (build -> commit -> sign-tag -> publish) so verification does not rely solely on mutable release assets, paired with atomic same-directory installation in scripts/install.sh.
